reusedExistingAdapters: updateAdminProduct (src/lib/catalogStore.ts:588-763) for creating missing seed-backed products (expectedRevision: 0) and updating existing stored products (expectedRevision: currentRevision)
validateHamperBoxPricing + storedHamperBoxRecord (src/lib/hamperBoxSchema.ts & src/lib/catalogStore.ts) inside db.runTransaction with snapshot.exists precondition and catalogAudits logging
loadAuthoritativeCatalog(db, { fresh: true }) for post-write authoritative read-back verification
steps: 1. Pre-flight read: Fetch current revision and full document snapshot for each approved target ID in products and hamperBoxes; abort immediately if any target revision differs from expectedRevision (or if a missing doc was concurrently created). Confirm products/pista is NOT in the write target set.

2. Apply approved product writes one by one via updateAdminProduct({ db, productId, body: { expectedRevision, ...approvedFields }, actorUid }), which runs inside db.runTransaction, validates via validateDynamicProduct, increments revision, preserves untouched fields/prices/MOQ behavior, and writes an atomic PRODUCT_UPDATED entry to catalogAudits.

3. Apply approved hamperBoxes writes via db.runTransaction using validateHamperBoxPricing({ schemaVersion: 1, boxId, revision: 1, price: approvedPrice, active: approvedActive }, boxId), checking !snap.exists (or expectedRevision match if already created) and writing an atomic HAMPER_BOX_CREATED/HAMPER_BOX_UPDATED entry to catalogAudits.

4. Post-write verification: Run loadAuthoritativeCatalog(db, { fresh: true }) and verify exact stored fields, revisions, option labels, prices, dynamic MOQs, and products/pista (revision 2: 1200/2200/4500 PKR, pricePer100g: 500) integrity.
